issue_title: Low recall for severity level 1 (medium risk) conversations

issue_summary.title: Severity=1 (medium) is frequently under-detected (low recall)
issue_summary.overview: Across reasoning levels, recall for severity label 1 is low (minimal: 0.2675, low: 0.2382, medium: 0.2544, high: 0.2581). This indicates many medium-risk conversations are misclassified as 2 or 0, which can blur triage and overwhelm escalation or miss early interventions.
issue_summary.desired_behavior: Improve sensitivity for severity 1 while maintaining specificity for 0 and 2.
issue_summary.observed_behavior: The model often maps ambiguous or concerning content to 2 (over-escalation) or 0 (under-sensitivity), yielding f1 for label 1 in the 0.32–0.36 range.
issue_summary.self_assessed_severity_justification: Performance limitation without direct harmful content; operational impact on triage quality.
issue_summary.self_assessed_breadth_justification: Affects all evaluation subsets where label 1 is present.
